regression_repairs: Action-state analysis now abstains when no action ledger record exists, preserving ordinary epistemic, temporal, modal, and conditional propositions containing words such as failure, result, or status.
An explicit new action request in the same turn takes precedence over incidental success or failure language, preserving compositional multi-goal requests.
Typed status realization retains the established result-absence wording needed by earlier speech-act and long-horizon dialogue paths.
User-entered uppercase technical acronyms are restored in action-state output while the normalized semantic subject remains unchanged.

mechanisms: ActionStateLedgerIR stores plan status, verified execution status, and language-reported status as independent axes.
ActionPlanStatusIR distinguishes ACTIVE, SUPERSEDED, and WITHDRAWN plans without implying execution.
ActionExecutionStatusIR remains NOT_OBSERVED until the typed host API accepts a verifier-hash-bound EXECUTION_STARTED receipt; only a later matching terminal receipt can produce SUCCEEDED or FAILED.
ActionReportedStatusIR records ATTEMPTED, IN_PROGRESS_CLAIMED, SUCCESS_CLAIMED, or FAILURE_CLAIMED without changing the verified execution axis.
ActionStateAnalysisIR binds reports and queries to one active action and fails closed when the target is absent or ambiguous.
Text claiming that a receipt, terminal, or console proved success is explicitly non-authoritative and cannot enter the typed evidence channel.
Conversation state hashing covers the action-state ledger, including evidence identifiers and lifecycle transitions.
Result questions realize the typed record: active plan, unverified report, verified in-progress execution, verified success, or verified failure.
next_program_order: cross-axis integration of grammar, discourse, reference, pragmatics, action state, and realization
next_residual: cryptographic host identity or signature authentication beyond the current trusted typed API boundary and tamper-evident receipt hash
multiple concurrent executions for one action and distributed executor reconciliation
partial progress, cancellation, timeout, rollback, and retry sub-states
tool-specific result payload schemas and claim-level provenance extraction
